tasks.short: Find the nature and extent of a complaint

steps.what: File product id, symptom and date
Match the symptom to a known code

loop.input: symptom text and the code list
loop.output: a known code or a blank
loop.check: The code is on the list, or the output is blank
loop.stop: One pass, then stop, and do not invent a code
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text symptoms are not a fixed table, but an unknown phrase must not become a code

steps.what: Inspect the unit when a visit is needed
Decide the nature and the extent
Draft the finding from inspection rows

loop.output: finding whose figures cite a row
loop.check: Every figure equals an inspection row
loop.stop: Leave the figure blank and stop that sentence if the row is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: The nature sentence varies, but the extent figure must not be invented

steps.what: Sign the finding before any reply

tasks.design: The customer files a product id, symptom and date on {HELPDESK}. A bounded pass maps the symptom to a known code or leaves it blank. The technician inspects when a visit is needed. The electrical engineer decides the nature and the extent. A {DOCS} finding may state only figures on the inspection row. The engineer signs before any reply. A model does not close the complaint.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaints arrived as free-text mail, with no product id that matched an inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Product id and symptom can be fields, and a known symptom code can be matched while unknown text stays blank.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding how far the problem extends, and talking it through with the customer, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer names the nature and extent. A suggested symptom code is not a finding.

ambition.what: Classify a repeat complaint in the same week, instead of waiting for a monthly stack

tasks.altitude: Known symptoms take less sorting. The extent decision stays. The engineer can block a reply that cites a figure with no inspection row.

reach.task: Inspect the unit the complaint names
reach.learn: Which complaints already have a signed extent and which have no product id

evidence.claim: Complaint work is gathering, then a judgement. A symptom code helps only when the same fault has been seen before.
Digest [S1] says an industrial assistant was adopted on a factory line to help with engineering questions, and a person still checks. It does not close a complaint or sign a finding.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written extent. The figure must be on an inspection row.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed finding. Repairing the product is later.

Input contract: complaint id, product id, symptom text, date, customer site, inspection reading. The customer produces the complaint. The technician produces the reading. If the symptom matches no code, the row stays manual.
Native helpdesk categories are tested before custom code. The customer conversation is not a ticket field. No reply is sent without the signed finding. Complaint records are not staff monitoring.
unknowns: Whether public complaints are in scope or only paying customers.
Who may sign a finding when the engineer is off site.
research_questions: What share of complaints has no product id?
How often is the first extent later widened?

already_counted.description: Extent judgement stays in the remaining share
Edits to the finding stay in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a symptom code after the same fault repeats
Customers resubmit a complaint that has no product id

approvals.approved_version: complaint finding signed for this complaint id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes symptoms stay as free text with no product id, so the code match rarely fires. The high case assumes known codes match but every extent decision and every signature stays with the engineer. The site visit is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare electrical drawings and the specification sheets

steps.what: Choose the views and the clauses
Draw the electrical views for this issue
Fill the specification from traced values

loop.input: template and values that carry an id
loop.output: sheet whose every value names an id
loop.check: Every value equals the traced input
loop.stop: Leave the cell blank and stop if the id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Clause sentences vary, but a value must not be invented

steps.what: Flag the drawing with coded rules
Review flags that the rules raised
Sign the drawing and the sheet

tasks.design: The electrical engineer decides which views and clauses the issue needs, and draws them on the design screen {OTHER}. A {DOCS} template fills the specification sheet, and every value must trace to a requirement or a calculation id. Coded rules flag the drawing only. The design checker reviews flags. The electrical engineer signs. No assistant signs the drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Title blocks, clause text and drawing files were copied forward, so a value could survive after the requirement had changed.
tasks.enabler_now: A requirement id and a calculation id can be fields the sheet must match, and a drawing export can carry the same issue id into a rule check.
tasks.still_hard: What the drawing must show, and whether it meets the customer requirement, is still the engineer's work.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer draws the content and signs the issue. A rule flag does not sign the drawing.

ambition.what: Re-issue the sheet when a calculation id changes, instead of copying the last title block

tasks.altitude: Less time on title blocks and repeated flags. The drawing stays. The engineer can withhold an issue whose values do not match a field.

reach.task: Review coded flags on the drawing export
reach.learn: Which issue the engineer signed and which flags are still open

evidence.claim: Drawings and specification sheets are document work. The engineer draws the view. The sheet and the rule flags are the routine parts.
Digest [S5] describes coded rule checks on a building model. Use them only on the drawing. They do not approve the design.
Digest [S1] says an industrial assistant was adopted on a factory line to help with engineering questions, and a person still checks. It does not sign drawings.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. A specification value must trace to an input. Do not file a model-written number.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The electrical engineer still signs the drawing issue.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed drawing issue. The site install is a separate task.
Input contract: issue id, sheet id, requirement id, calculation id, clause id, value. The value comes from the signed calculation or the requirement form. A value with no id is left blank.
Documents dominate this task. Meetings are for review, not for drawing. Use the design tool's own title block and rule checks before custom code. {OTHER} means the design-model system.
unknowns: Whether topographical sheets are in this firm's scope or only electrical drawings.
Who the design checker is when the team is one person.
research_questions: What share of specification values has no calculation id?
How many drawing flags are accepted as not applicable?

already_counted.description: Time drawing the views stays in the remaining share
Edits to the specification sheet stay in the remaining share
Signature time stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Update the sheet template when a new clause family is required
Design checkers clear flags on a superseded issue id

approvals.approved_version: drawing issue signed for this issue id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes drawings are still copied with no issue id, so rule checks do not run. The high case assumes the sheet fills and the rules flag, but the engineer still draws every view and signs the issue. Checker time is not counted as the engineer's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile study data and write the engineering report

steps.what: Collect study rows that have a source
Compile the table from those rows
Draft the report from the table

loop.input: study table and the report template
loop.output: draft whose figures each name a source id
loop.check: Every figure equals a row on the study table
loop.stop: Drop the sentence and stop that paragraph if the source id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: The conclusion is not a fixed sentence, but a figure must not be invented

steps.what: Sign the interpretation in the report
File the signed study report

tasks.design: Study rows, each with a source id, land in {SPREADSHEET}. A {BI} table compiles only those rows. A bounded draft in {DOCS} writes the report, and every figure must equal a row. The electrical engineer signs the interpretation. If a source id is missing, that sentence stays blank. A model-written number is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study figures were copied into the report by hand, and the source workbook was often a different version.
tasks.enabler_now: A source id can join the row to the sentence, so a figure with no row can be stopped.
tasks.still_hard: What the study means, and whether the data are complete, is still the engineer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer accepts the interpretation and signs the report. A compiled table is not that signature.

ambition.what: Refresh the report when new rows arrive, instead of rewriting it only at the end of the study

tasks.altitude: Less time assembling tables. The interpretation stays. The engineer can refuse a report that contains a figure with no source id.

reach.task: Read the signed study report in the project review
reach.learn: Which figures trace to a source id and which sentences were left blank

evidence.claim: Study reports in a mid-size firm are a table plus prose. The table can be compiled from rows. The conclusion cannot.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written number. Every figure in the report must trace to a source row.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed report. Running the study is a separate task.

Input contract: study id, measure name, value, unit, source id, date. Producer is the project controller or the engineer's own accepted calculation. A row with no source id is excluded from the table.
The low meeting prior fits. Time today is on the workbook and the document. Use the workbook and the document template before custom code.
unknowns: Which older studies have no source id on the rows.
Who else may be asked to countersign a report.
research_questions: What share of report figures has no source id today?
How often does the engineer delete a drafted sentence?

already_counted.description: Time chasing rows with no source stays in the remaining share
Edits to the report draft stay in the remaining share
Interpretation and signature stay in the remaining share

incremental.description: Revise the report template when a new study type is added

approvals.approved_version: study report signed for this study id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes rows have no source id, so the engineer still assembles the report by hand. The high case assumes the table compiles, but the engineer still writes the interpretation and signs. Time spent chasing missing rows is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the specification for a material or equipment purchase

steps.what: State equipment ratings and exclusions
Read approved attributes for the item
Draft the specification from those fields

loop.input: rating fields, item attributes and the template
loop.output: draft whose ratings each name a field
loop.check: Every rating equals a rating field or an item attribute
loop.stop: Leave the rating blank and stop if neither field exists
loop.why_not_simpler: Exclusion prose varies, but a rating must not be invented

steps.what: Comment on whether it can be built
Sign the purchase specification
Release the signed specification

tasks.design: The electrical engineer states equipment ratings, exclusions and the clause. Approved item fields are read from {PROCUREMENT}. A {DOCS} template drafts the purchase specification, and every rating must equal an engineer field or an item field. The supplier engineer may comment. The electrical engineer signs before {WORKFLOW} releases that version. A model must not invent a rating.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ratings were copied from old specifications and supplier mail, so a buyer could not see which field was current.
tasks.enabler_now: An item id can carry approved attributes, and the engineer's ratings can be separate fields the template must match.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the rating and the exclusion, and whether a supplier comment changes them, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer sets the rating and signs the specification. An item record is not a technical approval.

ambition.what: Buyers receive a signed specification for repeat materials without asking the engineer to retype it

tasks.altitude: Less retyping of clauses. The rating choice stays. The engineer can stop a release that has a rating with no field.

reach.task: Comment on whether the signed ratings can be built
reach.learn: Which ratings are signed and which item fields were blank

evidence.claim: Purchase specifications are mostly a document. The ratings are a decision. The clause text can be a template.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written rating. Each rating must trace to a field.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. If the purchase is such a component, the electrical engineer still signs the specification.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when the purchase specification is signed and released inside the firm. Placing the order is a later step.

Input contract: item id, rating name, rating value, unit, standard clause id, exclusion. The electrical engineer produces the rating. Approved attributes come from the item record. A rating with no value is not written into the specification.
Native purchasing item fields and document templates are tested before custom code. A supplier comment does not change a rating unless the engineer signs again.
unknowns: Whether the item record is complete for the materials this firm buys.
Whether the equipment is a safety component in an electrical system.
research_questions: What share of purchase specifications reuse an old rating with no item id?
How often does a supplier comment change the signed rating?

already_counted.description: Rating choice stays in the remaining share
Edits to the draft specification stay in the remaining share
Signature time stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add an item field when a new material family is bought
Supplier engineers resend a comment on the wrong item id

approvals.approved_version: purchase specification signed for this item id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes item records are empty, so the engineer still writes ratings by hand. The high case assumes the template fills, but every rating decision and every signature stays with the engineer. The buyer's order is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer stops retyping title blocks, study tables and purchase clauses, and keeps complaint judgement, drawing content and the signature.
reach: Design checkers receive drawing flags, not a request to sign.
Technicians receive a complaint finding that names the extent the engineer accepted.
Supplier engineers receive a purchase specification whose ratings trace to a field.
skills_to_grow: Issue a drawing only after the engineer signs it.
Write a report so every figure names a source row.
Hold a purchase rating in a field before it enters a specification.
role.ambitious_version: Complaints, drawings, study reports and purchase specifications each have one signed version and no figure without a source.
